name: Depth-Guided Robust and Fast Point Cloud Fusion NeRF
definition: A NeRF framework for sparse input views that perceives radiance fields as an explicit voxel grid of features, constructs a point cloud for each input view, accumulates them into a fused point cloud, and refines depth inaccuracies by referencing the fused point cloud.
summary: Depth-Guided Robust and Fast Point Cloud Fusion NeRF is a novel-view synthesis method that uses point cloud fusion to correct depth inaccuracies, ensuring robust geometry estimation while achieving significantly smaller model sizes and faster training times than existing NeRF variants.
